steps.command: rm -rf src && mkdir src && cd src && git init -q . && git remote add origin https://github.com/pmndrs/zustand.git && git fetch -q --depth 1 origin d7a5583cffd80af515f7dfb69583c95cbdc9e2ce && git checkout -q FETCH_HEAD && test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = d7a5583cffd80af515f7dfb69583c95cbdc9e2ce

python --version && mkdir -p /workspace/sdk/uv && curl -fsSL -o /tmp/uv.tar.gz https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/releases/download/0.12.17/uv-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz && echo 'fa82fd8dde8e8eefdecada6aa0889666556cfceb690d06e0c3bca49eb3070a63  /tmp/uv.tar.gz' | sha256sum -c - && tar -C /workspace/sdk/uv --strip-components=1 -xzf /tmp/uv.tar.gz && export PATH=/workspace/sdk/uv:$PATH && uv --version
export PATH=/workspace/sdk/uv:$PATH && uv sync --no-dev --group tests --extra all
export PATH=/workspace/sdk/uv:$PATH && uv run --no-sync bash scripts/test-cov.sh $PYTEST_OPTIONS

rm -rf src && mkdir src && cd src && git init -q . && git remote add origin https://github.com/gin-gonic/gin.git && git fetch -q --depth 1 origin 43fe48e8a0f44af783116cdb010725e6bb50255f && git checkout -q FETCH_HEAD && test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 43fe48e8a0f44af783116cdb010725e6bb50255f
mkdir -p /workspace/sdk && curl -fsSL https://go.dev/dl/go1.27.1.linux-amd64.tar.gz | tar -C /workspace/sdk -xz && export PATH=/workspace/sdk/go/bin:$PATH && go version

export PATH=/workspace/sdk/go/bin:$PATH && echo "mode: count" > coverage.out && for d in github.com/gin-gonic/gin github.com/gin-gonic/gin/ginS github.com/gin-gonic/gin/binding github.com/gin-gonic/gin/render; do go test -v -covermode=count -coverprofile=profile.out "$d" > tmp.out || { cat tmp.out; exit 1; }; cat tmp.out; grep -v mode: profile.out >> coverage.out; done

rm -rf src && mkdir src && cd src && git init -q . && git remote add origin https://github.com/aome510/spotify-player.git && git fetch -q --depth 1 origin 7dc9d17a7bf5671eb6129fdf9127729f659637fc && git checkout -q FETCH_HEAD && test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 7dc9d17a7bf5671eb6129fdf9127729f659637fc
sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq build-essential pkg-config libssl-dev libasound2-dev libdbus-1-dev libxcb-shape0-dev libxcb-xfixes0-dev

curl -fsSL -o /tmp/rustup-init https://static.rust-lang.org/rustup/archive/1.29.2/x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/rustup-init && echo '5be191e8c70a5007074254cb74d78dbfdd25cd5a61c27de7b8e5410122ec24f4  /tmp/rustup-init' | sha256sum -c - && chmod +x /tmp/rustup-init && /tmp/rustup-init -y --no-modify-path --profile minimal --default-toolchain 1.98.1 --component clippy,rustfmt && export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" && rustc --version

rm -rf src && mkdir src && cd src && git init -q . && git remote add origin https://github.com/jqlang/jq.git && git fetch -q --depth 1 origin 49fbca1242c7f46f00b849de76565764e0254a03 && git checkout -q FETCH_HEAD && test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 49fbca1242c7f46f00b849de76565764e0254a03 && git submodule update --init --force --depth=1
sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y automake autoconf libtool crossbuild-essential-amd64

autoreconf -i && ./configure --host=x86_64-linux-gnu --disable-docs --with-oniguruma=builtin --enable-static --enable-all-static CFLAGS="-O2 -pthread -fstack-protector-all" && make -j"$(nproc)" && file ./jq && cp ./jq jq-linux-amd64
